choose-destination: Choose where the app should file things first.
contents-unreadable: The file's contents could not be read.
data-dir-not-absolute: The data location must be an absolute path.
file-changed-since-preview: The file changed after the preview, so it was left alone.
file-exists: A file with that name already exists.
file-not-processed: The file could not be processed.
folder-name-not-portable: “{folder}” isn't a valid folder name on both macOS and Windows.
folder-unreadable: The folder could not be read.
ids-not-unique: Rule and collection ids must be unique.
image-not-converted: The image could not be converted.
image-unreadable: The image could not be read.
name-required: Every rule and collection needs a name.
no-permission: The app doesn't have permission to change this file.
preview-out-of-date: This preview is out of date. Please review it again.
restored-with-new-name: {count} file(s) were restored with a new name because a different file now uses the original name.
rules-reset: Your rules could not be read, so the defaults were restored. The old file was kept.
save-failed: The app could not save its settings.
settings-set-aside: Saved settings could not be read and were set aside.
undo-history-cleared: Undo history could not be read and was cleared.
undo-history-not-saved: Undo history could not be saved.
undo-not-saved-after-apply: Changes were made, but undo history could not be saved; undo works until the app quits.
workspace-changed: This folder changed since it was analysed. Please refresh and try again.
